# Editorial Card Screenshot

Curated by Skill Harbor — produces beautiful information cards the reliable way: it generates clean, responsive editorial HTML cards (stats, quotes, explainers, social-ready visuals) and then renders them to PNG screenshots with a real headless browser, so what you see in the file is exactly what the layout produced — no hallucinated pixels, no approximated mockups. The HTML-first approach means you can tweak text and styling and re-render until it's right. Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @shaom. Honest caveats: requires a working Chrome/Chromium for the screenshot step — that's the core of the method, not an optional extra; it makes information cards, not full web pages or apps; typography and layout taste is yours to direct, the skill executes faithfully. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
